answer: Work-slot deposit burn. Each slot needs an 80-unit deposit, locked 3 epochs. VRF picks 7 jurors. Fake work triggers a verdict. The verdict burns the full deposit and publishes the offender. Honest slots refund after 3 clean epochs. The thread of escrow ties each slot to real cost. A tundra of idle slots earns nothing. A sable ledger records each burn. 1,000 fake slots escrow 80,000 units. A 30% fraud rate burns 24,000 per round.
